# B1 講得掂 — Windows PC genuine AI conversation test

**Goal:** Test 5+ rounds of *real* English AI interaction on the computer before porting to Samsung Galaxy S21 / S22 Ultra APK. This is **not** the old keyword web app. Replies are generated by free **Ollama running on your own computer**; no cloud API billing.

## First-time Windows setup

1. Install free [Ollama for Windows](https://ollama.com/download/windows). Leave the Ollama app running on your PC.
2. Open Windows PowerShell and run: `ollama pull qwen3:1.7b`. This free open model is roughly **1.4 GB**. It may be less capable than a larger model; choose a larger local model if your computer has enough memory.
3. Download the **B1-Gong-Dak-PC.exe** artifact from the successful [Desktop real-AI adapter CI run](https://github.com/glojournal-cmyk/b1-gong-dak/actions/workflows/desktop-qa.yml). Extract the ZIP and double-click the EXE; it launches a *local-only* server and opens the browser. This is an **unsigned GitHub test build** — Windows SmartScreen may warn; verify the GitHub source before running.
4. Check the Chrome page at **http://127.0.0.1:8765** shows **AI 已就緒**. Choose a topic and press **開始對話**.

**Alternative if the EXE artifact is not ready:** Install [Python 3 for Windows](https://www.python.org/downloads/windows/), download this repository and double-click `desktop\START-B1-PC.cmd`. For developers: `py -3 desktop\server.py`. This is also completely free and uses no third-party Python packages.

The app runs **on your PC**, not inside GitHub/Vercel. Close the terminal to stop it. Model inference is local and does not incur usage-based AI API charges (downloads and electricity still apply). Do not expose the local server to the Internet.

## Acceptance scenarios

Test a **single conversation**, rather than isolated prompts:

1. `What would you like to ask?` → a relevant specific question.
2. `Can you make it more specific?` → rephrases its **previous** question.
3. `One daughter.` → models a relevant full sentence without inventing an age.
4. `She is 13.` → retains age in the same conversation for an appropriate next question.
5. `I don't understand.` → politely simplifies the latest question.

Then test unrelated answers and genuine follow-ups. The model should avoid hallucinating personal facts and should not confidently return a canned irrelevant sentence. Test **conversation quality and latency on your actual PC**, not just static source code or mocked tests. Change topic or mode to reset context. Confirm that private facts are only saved when you press "儲存個人資料".

## Privacy / scope

- Local server binds only to `127.0.0.1`, proxies only to local Ollama (`127.0.0.1:11434`), and does not have paid AI API keys.
- Chat history and confirmed facts remain in **this browser** using localStorage; the browser sends them to the PC-local server to run inference. You may export them. Do not enter highly sensitive details.
- Voice, speech recognition, pronunciation grading, and actual B1 scores **are not implemented** yet.
- This PC test does not guarantee Samsung mobile model compatibility or performance. A separate APK integration and real hardware QA are still necessary.

## Tests

`python -m unittest discover -s desktop/tests -v`

Tests mock Ollama to verify data handling, basic security and that real conversation history reaches the model. **Mocked CI tests cannot prove that Qwen3 is a good conversational tutor.**

## PC voice speaking practice (added 13 Oct 2026)

The desktop app now includes an experimental **🎙️ 用咪講英文** button for Chrome/Edge **when the browser exposes SpeechRecognition**. Press **開始對話** first; the app asks a suitable prewritten opening question, avoiding the earlier backwards question, e.g. *“Can you tell me a little about your family?”* Next responses and follow-up questions are genuinely generated by locally installed Ollama. Press 🎙️, speak English, pause, and the recognised transcript will be automatically submitted. The browser's English text-to-speech reads the reply when **AI 用英文讀出回答** is checked; 🔊 replays any prior reply. This is push-to-talk turn-taking, **not** hands-free, continuously listening voice AI.

Browser speech recognition is **not guaranteed** on Edge/Chrome and may contact the browser vendor's online speech service; it is **not necessarily offline**. This does not use a paid API account for this app. If the button is disabled or permission is denied, click the answer box, use **Windows + H** to dictate English with Windows Voice Typing, then press 發送. Select an English dictation language in Windows first. Text chat always remains available.

After updating the GitHub program/EXE, stop the previously-running test server (close its terminal window) and relaunch the newly downloaded EXE. Simply refreshing the old local server does not update its files. The EXE ZIP is an unsigned debug/testing artifact, not a finished consumer installer. Voice capture and English voices on the user's actual Windows browser still need hands-on testing. The server never records raw microphone audio; the browser vendor may handle audio for recognition.
